desktop.name: 01-find
desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Salus Korean personal meal/recipe product, completely new TASK-FIRST design. Actual product screenshot, NOT marketing concept board. Prior cream/serif/green-card template was rejected.
Pure WHITE #FFFFFF working area; #F3F4F3 navigation only; #252927 text; #626862 secondary; #30543D forest ONLY for current selection and one primary action. One Korean sans family similar to SUIT, body16, sections18, titles26-30, two weights. Lowercase sans "salus" wordmark, no leaf. Standard usable 48px controls, 6px corners. Group via spacing, not cards or newspaper rules.
NO photography, food pictures/drawings/icons, illustrations, mascots, blobs, gradients, sparkles, decorative shapes/numbers/eyebrows, serif headings, all-caps labels, middle-dot metadata, arrows on every link, pills, nested cards, card grids, thick colored edges, artificial grain or repeated shadows. Only useful consistent line icons. No fabricated sources, reviews, metrics or safe guarantees.
Plain direct Korean copy. No "나에게 맞게", "조금 더 편하게", "반가워요", "가볍게 시작", "차곡차곡" slogans.
ONE full-size SINGLE desktop screen, 1536x1024 landscape, orthographic screenshot, no hardware/browser frame, no phone companion, no presentation labels. Crisp legible Korean. No theatrical headings or comical empty space. Useful date/meal context gives identity where relevant.
Public landing and immediate recipe entry. NO split hero, right-hand feature card, giant statement, three-column process or big marketing sections.
Top white header64: small salus x48 left and single 로그인 far right. No authenticated bottom nav.
Main SINGLE760px column centered horizontally, all text LEFT ALIGNED, starts110px below header. Actual date "10월 30일 금요일", then30px title "오늘 저녁, 뭘로 만들까요?"
Space30. Permanent label "재료나 먹고 싶은 요리". Large subtle bordered textarea visibly filled with TWO lines: "양배추 반 통이랑 닭고기가 있어요." / "20분 안에 만들 수 있는 요리를 찾아줘." Plenty writing room; subtle visible keyboard focus outline, not glow. No attachment, microphone or model selector.
Directly below action row: small plain link "알레르기 정보 입력" left; ONE solid forest button "요리 찾기" right.
Next modest heading "이렇게 물어볼 수 있어요" and TWO unboxed TEXT ROW buttons: "두부로 만들 수 있는 저녁 메뉴 알려줘" / "냉장고에 있는 재료로 간단한 한 끼". No results before submitting, no duplicate CTA, cards or 01/02/03.
Below useful sentence "로그인하면 레시피를 저장하고 먹은 식사를 기록할 수 있어요." Actual bottom 이용약관 개인정보처리방침.
Content concentrated in upper two-thirds, balanced useful first-use product, not a giant blank search billboard. No food imagery or decorative substitutes.
